correctness.rationale: TARGET route: submitted headline is disproof H3(UConf_n(Theta_(2,3,4));Z)=0 for all n, hence s_*:0->0, coker 0, no Z/2, rational map vacuously surjective. Verified step-by-step: (1) Theta_(2,3,4) subdivided model inventory 8V/9E/chi=-1/valences (3,3,2^6) correct, replayed VERIFY_OK. (2) Smoothing to minimal theta (2 vertices, 3 parallel edges) is a homeomorphism of underlying 1-complexes, so B_n homeomorphic and integral homology identical; graph-morphism discussion unnecessary but harmless. (3) Reduced Swiatkowski complex degree bound: each vertex contributes at most one degree-1 factor (empty vs h_i-h_j), so degree <= |V|. Applied to Gamma_min with |V|=2 gives C_d=0 for d>=3 in every weight, hence C_3=0 at weights 5,6 and H_3=ker/im=0/0=0. Transferred by (2) to Theta_(2,3,4). Holds for any coefficients. Stabilization-cokernel logic 0->0 correct; choice of edge irrelevant. Evidence type is PROOF modulo cited standard quasi-isomorphism H_*(B)≅H_*(~S) (ADK Thm 2.10 / Prop 4.9) and homeomorphism-invariance, both correctly cited not re-proved; script only certifies trivial combinatorics C(2,3)=0 and chi inventory. No boundary error: bound independent of weight n, covers all n including small n. Ordered configs explicitly excluded. No computation defect.

originality.rationale: Submitted vanishing H3=0 for a 2-essential-vertex graph is substantively implied by prior stronger theorems. It is a direct corollary of the known homological-dimension bound and of the Theta_n homology tables, not a new map-level fact. Fails adversarial coverage: synonymous encodings, broader theorems, and exact family tables all cover it. See decisive_checks. Timestamp/failed search cannot establish priority; prior need not state Theta_(2,3,4) verbatim.

value.rationale: Correct disproof that admitted target conjunction is impossible, but as a standalone retrieval it is a textbook restatement / immediate corollary of the standard Swiatkowski degree bound with no new invariant, method, or downstream use. The object (theta graph) is natural and was motivated by the target, but the value H3=0 is mechanically implied by the 2-essential-vertex bound and already contained in Theta_n Betti formulas (only i=0,1,2 non-zero). No general theorem, no new witness (witness clause is unsatisfiable by definition once C_3=0), no motivated exact datum a future researcher would need to retrieve beyond the standard bound. Correcting an ill-posed target premise does not by itself create independently retrievable value under the narrow-datum standard. Intrinsic low value / textbook corollary => REJECT, not repairable via bounded addition.
